items.title: TA’ZIZ完成51亿迪拉姆融资，推进Ruwais两大工业项目
items.title_en: TA’ZIZ closes AED5.1 billion financing for two industrial projects in Ruwais
items.sector: 工业化工与基础设施融资
items.summary: TA’ZIZ在11月4日宣布为Ruwais的工业化工码头及氨厂项目完成合计51亿迪拉姆融资，其中码头约34.1亿迪拉姆，氨厂约16.9亿迪拉姆；氨厂设计产能100万吨/年，相关EPC工程进度分别超过90%与约70%。融资完成不是新授标。
items.summary_en: On 4 November, TA’ZIZ announced the financial close of AED5.1 billion for its Ruwais terminal and ammonia projects, with approximately AED3.41 billion for the terminal and AED1.69 billion for the ammonia plant. The ammonia facility has 1 million tonnes per year of design capacity; respective EPC works are over 90% and around 70% complete. Financing close is not a new EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 融资确定性提高项目后期交付与运营机会，但大型总包工程已授予现有承包商。
items.why_it_matters_en: Financing supports final delivery and future operations, while principal EPC contracts have already been awarded.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进工业码头、氨厂后期安装、备件、运维及配套供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track late-stage installation, spare parts, operations and support procurement for the terminal and ammonia plant.

items.title: Borouge推进乙烷裂解装置EU2与EU3扩建前期工程
items.title_en: Borouge advances early engineering for EU2 and EU3 ethane cracker expansions
items.summary: Borouge International于11月4日公布与Linde Engineering合作开展EU2裂解装置扩建早期工程服务，拟增加23万吨/年产能；EU3另取得预FEED授予函。2030年1380万吨/年是集团整体产能目标，不是EU2单项扩建产能。
items.summary_en: On 4 November Borouge International announced early engineering work with Linde Engineering for expansion of its EU2 ethane cracker by 230,000 tonnes per year, alongside a pre-FEED award for EU3. The 13.8 million-tonne 2030 target refers to group-wide capacity, not the EU2 expansion alone.
items.why_it_matters: 设计及后续EPC筹备阶段可能产生工程设备与施工供应链需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Early engineering and EPC preparation may create equipment and industrial contracting opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注石化设备、管道、机械安装及EPC合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor petrochemical equipment, piping, mechanical installation and EPC partnerships.

items.title: 沙迦连接迪拜新道路项目第一阶段正式启用
items.title_en: Sharjah opens first phase of new road connections with Dubai
items.summary: 沙迦于11月4日启用连接迪拜新道路项目的第一阶段，包括Al Taawun交通枢纽部分道路与桥梁。相关工程道路总长约9.18公里，桥梁总长约753米，隧道总长约581米，雨水排水设施约19公里。第二阶段工程仍继续推进。
items.summary_en: Sharjah inaugurated the first phase of new road links with Dubai on 4 November, including parts of the Al Taawun junction and bridges. The programme comprises approximately 9.18 km of roads, 753 metres of bridges, 581 metres of tunnels and 19 km of drainage networks, with subsequent works continuing.
items.why_it_matters: 属于既有建设项目取得新阶段进展，而非新的道路总包招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a milestone in an existing infrastructure programme, not a fresh main-contract tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注剩余工程、交通设备、道路机电及配套维护采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor remaining works, road equipment, traffic systems and maintenance procurement.

items.title: 阿联酋启动10亿迪拉姆国家工业韧性基金融资申请
items.title_en: UAE opens applications for AED1 billion National Industrial Resilience Fund
items.summary: 阿联酋工业和先进技术部与Emirates Development Bank于11月4日开放国家工业韧性基金线上融资申请，基金规模10亿迪拉姆，支持关键产业本地化、制造业升级及供应链韧性。这是融资申请窗口，并非政府建设合同。
items.summary_en: On 4 November the UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology and Emirates Development Bank opened online applications to the AED1 billion National Industrial Resilience Fund to support critical-industry localisation, advanced manufacturing and supply-chain resilience. This is an industrial financing programme, not a construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 直接利于工业企业筹资和升级，但申请条件需以银行正式公布为准。
items.why_it_matters_en: The funding may enable industrial upgrades, subject to eligibility and credit assessment by the bank.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业设备、生产线改造、供应链与符合条件的企业合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor industrial equipment, production-line upgrades, supply chains and eligible enterprises.

items.title: 阿曼OIA与中国企业合作推进三处仓储物流设施
items.title_en: Oman OIA and Chinese partners advance three logistics warehousing locations
items.sector: 跨境物流与中国企业出海
items.summary: 阿曼投资局在11月2日中阿投资合作框架下公布Asyad Group与京东合作发展仓储与物流服务，拟首先在Muscat International Airport Free Zone、Khazaen Economic City及Sohar Free Zone建立三处配送仓库，探索自动化、网络互联与海湾及东非市场供应链服务。尚未公布仓库建筑总包授标。
items.summary_en: Within Oman Investment Authority's 2 November China partnership package, Asyad Group and JD.com agreed to develop warehousing and logistics solutions, starting with three proposed distribution warehouses at Muscat International Airport Free Zone, Khazaen Economic City and Sohar Free Zone, and exploring automation and network links to GCC and East African markets. No warehouse construction award was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 属于已宣布合作方案中的具体物流设施线索；并非11月5日新增签约。
items.why_it_matters_en: A specific warehousing initiative within an earlier announced partnership, not a new agreement signed on 5 November.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注仓库建设、自动化设备、运输和中国企业供应链配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor warehouse construction, automation, transport and Chinese cross-border logistics services.
items.source_name: Oman News Agency / Times of Oman

items.title: Energy Oman开放第二期伊斯兰债券机构认购
items.title_en: Energy Oman opens institutional subscription for second sukuk series
items.summary: Energy Development Oman于11月5日开放第二期伊斯兰债券机构认购，初始发行5000万阿曼里亚尔，可额外增发2500万里亚尔。期限5年，固定利润率每年5%，按季支付，机构认购截止11月12日。该项目属于融资产品，不是能源工程招标。
items.summary_en: Energy Development Oman opened institutional subscriptions for its second sukuk series on 5 November. The initial issue is RO50 million with a RO25 million greenshoe option, a five-year term and a fixed 5% annual profit rate paid quarterly. Institutional subscriptions close on 12 November. This is a financing instrument, not an energy EPC tender.
items.why_it_matters: 与能源融资市场相关，但对GCI工程供应链的直接商业价值有限。
items.why_it_matters_en: Relevant to energy financing conditions, but offers limited direct contracting opportunities for GCI.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注可能受融资支持的后续能源项目，不将债券发行视为工程订单。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor eventual energy-sector projects that financing may support, without treating the bond as a project order.

items.title: 尼日利亚Ogun州两处农业转化中心及32公里道路工程采购
items.title_en: Nigeria Ogun State tenders two agricultural transformation centres and 32 km roads
items.summary: 非洲开发银行支持的尼日利亚农业工业加工区计划SAPZ一期于10月22日公布采购，拟在Ogun州建设两处农业转化中心及32公里连接道路。该项目未在近7天GCI晨报出现，具体投标截止日和资质须查看招标附件确认。
items.summary_en: An African Development Bank-backed procurement notice dated 22 October seeks construction of two Agricultural Transformation Centres and 32 km of connecting roads in Ogun State under Nigeria's Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zones programme, Phase I. The exact bid deadline and eligibility conditions require verification in the tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 具有明确施工采购范围，可研究国际承包商及材料设备供应机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a defined construction procurement covering industrial facilities and roads, with potential contractor and supplier opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路工程、钢结构、土建、设备及建材供应合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor road works, structural steel, civil contracting, equipment and building materials.
